title: Website resources.json
description: Editor support for website resources.json. This schema validates custom alias declarations under aliases.custom.

aliases.description: Alias configuration for the website application.

custom.description: Custom aliases that Marketplace can prompt installers to configure.

propertyNames.description: Alias names must be 1 to 100 ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens.

customAliasDeclaration.title: Custom alias declaration
customAliasDeclaration.description: A custom alias value and optional metadata used when Marketplace prompts an installer.

value.description: The alias value. An empty string is valid. Values can contain at most 250 characters.

description.description: Optional installer-facing description, up to 500 characters.

required.description: Whether Marketplace must collect this alias from the installer. Defaults to false.
